question: How many iPhone units did Apple sell in fiscal 2025?
grading: Expected refusal: Apple does not disclose unit sales. May provide iPhone net sales from the 10-K, and may cite third-party shipment estimates only if clearly labeled as estimates with source.
answer: Apple did not disclose FY2025 iPhone unit sales in its 10-K. A reported unit count cannot be supplied. The filing reports iPhone net sales of USD 209,586 million; revenue is not a unit count, and third-party shipment estimates must be labeled as estimates. [G10-E1]

output.answer:
Apple **does not officially report** annual iPhone unit sales; the company stopped disclosing that metric starting in fiscal Q1 2019. The available figures for 2025 come from third-party analyst estimates:

- **IDC estimate**: ~**247 million** iPhones shipped in 2025 (a record annual total, up ~6% year-over-year)  
  [Source](https://sqmagazine.co.uk/how-many-iphones-sold)
  
- **Omdia estimate**: ~**240.6 million** global iPhone shipments in calendar 2025  
  [Source](https://marketviewinsights.com/statistics/apple-statistics)

- **Statista/Business of Apps estimates**: ~**247–248 million** units for 2025  
  [Source 1](https://www.statista.com/topics/870/iphone) | [Source 2](https://www.businessofapps.com/data/apple-statistics)

**Important caveats:**
- These are **analyst shipment estimates** (devices entering sales channels), not Apple-confirmed end-user sales.
- Estimates may refer to **calendar 2025** rather than Apple’s fiscal 2025 (which ended in late September 2025).
- Figures vary by research firm; for example, one estimate cited shipments around **220–225 million** as below expectations, though this appears to contrast with the more commonly cited ~247 million figure.

**Bottom line:** Based on widely cited IDC and Statista data, analysts estimate Apple shipped approximately **245–248 million iPhone units** in 2025, which would represent a record annual high if accurate.
